execute_help.stdout:
Usage: dopetask execute [OPTIONS]                                              
                                                                                
 Automatically discover, import, and execute the next runnable Task Packet.     
                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --agent        TEXT  Agent profile: gemini or codex. [default: gemini]       │
│ --model        TEXT  Optional explicit model override.                       │
│ --repo         PATH  Repository path.                                        │
│ --help               Show this message and exit.                             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

route_help.stdout:
Usage: dopetask route [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                              
                                                                                
 Assisted deterministic routing commands                                        
                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ init     Create repo-local route availability declaration.                   │
│ plan     Build deterministic route plan artifacts from packet +              │
│          availability.                                                       │
│ handoff  Generate deterministic handoff markdown (assisted only).            │
│ explain  Explain deterministic route scoring for a single step.              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

route_plan_help.stdout:
Usage: dopetask route plan [OPTIONS]                                           
                                                                                
 Build deterministic route plan artifacts from packet + availability.           
                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│    --repo-root                    PATH  Repository root path [default: .]    │
│ *  --packet                       PATH  Task Packet markdown path [required] │
│    --steps                        TEXT  Planned steps (repeatable and/or     │
│                                         comma-separated)                     │
│    --out                          PATH  Output path for ROUTE_PLAN.json      │
│                                         [default:                            │
│                                         out/dopetask_route/ROUTE_PLAN.json]  │
│    --explain      --no-explain          Include step reasons in markdown     │
│                                         report                               │
│                                         [default: explain]                   │
│    --help                               Show this message and exit.          │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

tp_exec_help.stdout:
Usage: dopetask tp exec [OPTIONS] TP_FILE                                      
                                                                                
 Execute a Task Packet using a specific agent profile.                          
                                                                                
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    tp_file      FILE  Generic Task Packet JSON file. [required]            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --agent          TEXT  Agent profile: gemini, codex, or claude_code.         │
│                        [default: gemini]                                     │
│ --model          TEXT  Optional explicit model override for the selected     │
│                        agent.                                                │
│ --dry-run              Compile and show prompts without executing.           │
│ --tmux                 Run execution inside an isolated tmux session.        │
│ --help                 Show this message and exit.                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

tp_series_exec_help.stdout:
Usage: dopetask tp series exec [OPTIONS] TP_FILE                               
                                                                                
 Execute a JSON Task Packet inside a DAG-aware series workflow.                 
                                                                                
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    tp_file      FILE  [required]                                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --agent        TEXT  Agent profile: gemini, codex, or claude_code.           │
│                      [default: gemini]                                       │
│ --model        TEXT  Optional explicit model override.                       │
│ --force              Force execution even if branch/worktree already exists  │
│                      (destructive).                                          │
│ --repo         PATH  Repository path.                                        │
│ --help               Show this message and exit.                             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
